mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`chat_group`(id, name, avatar, owner_id, notice, last_message, last_msg_at, create_time) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{ownerId}, #{notice}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMsgAt}, #{createTime})
insert into booknest.`chat_group_member`(id, group_id, user_id, role, last_read_at, join_time) values (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{lastReadAt}, #{joinTime})

insert into booknest.`chat_group_member`(id, group_id, user_id, role, last_read_at, join_time) values
(#{m.id}, #{m.groupId}, #{m.userId}, #{m.role}, #{m.lastReadAt}, #{m.joinTime})
mapper.select: select * from booknest.`chat_group_member` where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId}
select g.* from booknest.`chat_group` g inner join booknest.`chat_group_member` m on m.group_id = g.id where m.user_id = #{userId} order by g.last_msg_at desc, g.create_time desc

select m.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, m.role, m.join_time from booknest.`chat_group_member` m left join booknest.`user` u on u.id = m.user_id where m.group_id = #{groupId} order by (m.role = 'OWNER') desc, m.join_time asc
select user_id from booknest.`chat_group_member` where group_id = #{groupId}
select count(*) from booknest.`chat_group_member` where group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.delete: delete from booknest.`chat_group_member` where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select g.* from booknest.`chat_group` g where g.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') and not exists ( select 1 from booknest.`chat_group_member` m where m.group_id = g.id and m.user_id = #{userId} ) order by g.last_msg_at desc, g.create_time desc limit 30
